source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?nC) WHERE { VALUES ?cls { wd:Q16560 wd:Q23413 wd:Q751876 wd:Q1802963 wd:Q879050 } ?item wdt:P31 ?cls ; wdt:P17 ?c ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sl . FILTER(?sl >= 35) } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?nC = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 264

country.match: Match each palace or castle to its country.
country.odd: Three of these palaces and castles are in {value}. Which one isn't?
country.all: Tap all {n} palaces and castles in {value}.

rows.label: Tower of London
rows.description: castle in central London, United Kingdom
rows.hook: is guarded by Beefeaters and home to ravens said to protect the realm

rows.label: Balmoral Castle
rows.description: estate house in Royal Deeside, Aberdeenshire, Scotland, UK
rows.hook: is a royal Highland retreat where Queen Elizabeth II spent her summers and died

rows.label: Eltz Castle
rows.hook: sits in a forested Moselle valley and has stayed in one family for centuries

rows.label: Edinburgh Castle
rows.hook: stands on an extinct volcano and fires a gun every day at one o'clock

rows.label: Akershus Fortress
rows.description: former medieval castle in Oslo, Norway

rows.label: Amber Fort
rows.description: fort and palace in Rajasthan, India
rows.hook: lets visitors ride elephants up a hill to a palace with a Hall of Mirrors

rows.label: Schönbrunn Palace
rows.hook: was the Habsburgs' yellow summer residence and has the world's oldest zoo

rows.label: Bran Castle
rows.description: Medieval castle in Braşov county, Romania
rows.hook: is marketed as the home of Dracula, though the real Vlad barely stayed

rows.label: Prague Castle
rows.description: castle complex in Prague, Czech Republic, dating from the 9th century
rows.hook: is among the largest ancient fortified complexes, holding the Gothic St. Vitus Cathedral

rows.label: Malbork Castle
rows.description: castle built in Prussia (now Poland) by the Teutonic Knights

rows.label: Hohenzollern Castle
rows.description: ancestral seat of the imperial House of Hohenzollern in the Swabian Alps of central Baden-Württemberg, Germany

rows.label: Stirling Castle
rows.hook: perches on a crag where Mary, Queen of Scots was crowned as a baby

rows.label: Château de Chambord
rows.description: castle in Chambord, Centre-Val de Loire, France
rows.hook: is a Renaissance giant with a double-spiral staircase linked to Leonardo da Vinci
